overview_description.description: Thunder Compute develops a cloud GPU platform that provides on-demand GPU infrastructure for artificial intelligence, machine learning, and other compute-intensive workloads. The company uses proprietary GPU virtualization and orchestration technology to improve GPU utilization and make computing capacity available at lower costs. Its platform provides configurable GPU instances with persistent storage, fast provisioning, multi-GPU configurations, and developer tools including a web console, command-line interface, and VS Code integration. Thunder Compute also provides GPU virtualization software that can integrate with existing enterprise environments, including Kubernetes, Slurm, virtual machines, bare-metal GPU hosts, and cloud infrastructure, to increase usable capacity from existing GPU fleets. The company serves developers, researchers, startups, enterprises, and GPU infrastructure providers.
